description:
Share Lending, BORROW side: the Morpho Blue market that takes hhNVDA-CC fund shares as collateral for USDG — id (discovered from
        the lending vault at each call; the mainnet market is being migrated to a new oracle), LLTV, the ShareRiskOracle price and status
        (live / held / unavailable), borrow rate, utilization, supply, borrowed, available — and `my`: collateral, debt (interest to now),
        borrowing power, health factor, LTV and the liquidation price. Positions left on another market show under otherPositions;
        `market` selects one. Rule: keep LTV at or below 70% of LLTV. Read-only; nothing is sent.
name: borrow_status
